body.objective: Decide whether the strictly positive complete six-point local BT tree density has an ordinary finite integral across its physical factorization hypersurfaces.
activates: a regulated or inclusive probability gate
body.current_gate: Find an exact rank-five positive-energy physical point with one and only one transverse three-particle channel pole, derive the local density order and coefficient, and decide ordinary local integrability.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate proving ordinary integrability or a transverse divergence, without treating a regulator, finite part, detector cutoff, or real-virtual cancellation as already supplied.
body.forbid: no principal value assigned to a positive double pole by convention; no divergent exclusive tree integral called a physical probability; no scalar pole statement promoted to Eq. 19, loops, gravity, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL
body.resource_hint: Use D=(sum_A 1/s_A)^2+(1/8)sum_A 1/s_A^2. Certify a single transverse channel zero on the exact five-coordinate chart and keep the local phase-space Jacobian nonzero.
